crossRefs.note: Saul asked counsel of God, “Shall I go down after the Philistines? Will you deliver them into the hand of Israel?” But…
When Saul inquired of Yahweh, Yahweh didn’t answer him by dreams, by Urim, or by prophets.
“Son of man, these men have taken their idols into their heart, and put the stumbling block of their iniquity before…
So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”
He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to…
But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of…
They took the bull which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until…
When midday was past, they prophesied until the time of the evening offering; but there was no voice, no answer, and…
so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.
Many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and…
When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”
He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend, Lazarus, has fallen asleep, but I am going so that…
When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said…
Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

people.name: Gehazi
people.line: Elisha's servant; punished with leprosy for greed and deceit.

translations.web: Gehazi went ahead of them, and laid the staff on the child’s face; but there was no voice and no hearing. Therefore he returned to meet him, and told him, “The child has not awakened.”
translations.bsb: Gehazi went on ahead of them and laid the staff on the boy’s face, but there was no sound or response. So he went back to meet Elisha and told him, “The boy has not awakened.”
translations.kjv: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.
translations.asv: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he returned to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.
